steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F); lightly oil a 23 x 33 cm baking dish.
Finely dice the onion and mince the garlic; roughly chop the spinach.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Cook the onion for 3 to 4 minutes, until softened, then add the garlic and oregano for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, unsalted vegetable broth, cooked lentils, and rice.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish and stir in the chopped spinach.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 25 minutes, until the rice is cooked through.
Remove the foil, scatter the mozzarella over the top, and bake uncovered for 5 more minutes until melted.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving; yields one full dish · 4 family portions. Refrigerate up to 3 days.
